name: Jan
title: Jan: free ChatGPT alternative
hook: ChatGPT Plus charges you twenty bucks a month to chat with an AI assistant. This app does it for free.

features.intro: It runs AI right on your computer.
features.say: Download models like Llama, Gemma and Qwen, and chat with them offline.
Build custom assistants, or plug in cloud models like GPT and Claude.
It can even use tools, like searching Google for you.

caption:
ChatGPT Plus charges $20/month to chat with an AI assistant. Jan does it for free 🤖

✅ Download models like Llama, Gemma and Qwen and chat offline
✅ Custom assistants, plus cloud models like GPT and Claude if you want them
✅ Local server for other apps, and tools like web search
✅ No subscription, everything can run on your own computer

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ Local models are smaller than ChatGPT's best cloud models, and bigger ones need a decent computer: Jan suggests about 8GB of RAM for 3B models, 16GB for 7B and 32GB for 13B. ChatGPT Plus's $20 is the monthly price

Comment "OFFLINE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
